title: Bacolod to welcome over 35,000 participants for Batang Pinoy
summary: Bacolod City is gearing up for its hosting of the 2026 Batang Pinoy in December, which Mayor Greg Gasataya believes will be a "game-changer" for their grassroots sports program.
